items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Yeah, Peter first cousin and Henry first cousin. Peter and Henry's brothers. Peter, Henry, and Charlie's brothers.

ctx.x: Yeah, Peter first cousin and Henry first cousin. Peter and Henry's brothers. Peter, Henry, and Charlie's brothers. Mm-hmm. Go Charlie dead, Peter dead, but Henry live, and Henry's in Oakland.
Mm-hmm. Did you have alto horns in those bands?
